proof_body:
by
  intro R _ p q a h
  ext n
  rcases n with _ | _ | n
  · simp
  · simp [sub_mul, mul_assoc, PowerSeries.coeff_succ_X_mul, pow_succ, PowerSeries.coeff_C]
  · have h1 : PowerSeries.coeff (n + 1 + 1) (PowerSeries.C p * PowerSeries.X * PowerSeries.mk a) = p * a (n + 1) := by
      rw [mul_assoc, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_succ_X_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
    have h2 : PowerSeries.coeff (n + 1 + 1) (PowerSeries.C q * PowerSeries.X ^ 2 * PowerSeries.mk a) = q * a n := by
      rw [mul_assoc, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, pow_two, mul_assoc, PowerSeries.coeff_succ_X_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_succ_X_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
    have h3 : PowerSeries.coeff (n + 1 + 1) (PowerSeries.C (a 0) + PowerSeries.C (a 1 - p * a 0) * (PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries R)) = 0 := by
      rw [map_add, PowerSeries.coeff_C, if_neg (by omega), mul_comm, PowerSeries.coeff_succ_X_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_C, if_neg (by omega)]; simp
    rw [h3, sub_mul, sub_mul, map_sub, map_sub, h1, h2, one_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, h n]
    ring
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (p q : R) (a : ℕ → R), (∀ n, a (n + 2) = p * a (n + 1) + q * a n) → (1 - PowerSeries.C p * PowerSeries.X - PowerSeries.C q * PowerSeries.X ^ 2) * PowerSeries.mk a = PowerSeries.C (a 0) + PowerSeries.C (a 1 - p * a 0) * PowerSeries.X
